note: Hand-written source of the chapter 1 ⚡ stage (Build B1, 17 Nov 2026). tools/build_stretch.py turns it into content/ms/stretch/x01.json. Chapter 1 has one extension word («saudari»), so this stage is mostly review: longer frames and a longer dialogue with the chapter 1 words. Malay: Malaysian standard, standard form first, no spoken forms, no faith-specific greetings, chapter 1 words only (no «hai» or «helo»: they are not ledger words). All Japanese is a draft for the native check.

L-1506.en: Formal: Miss / Ms, or a formal «you» for a woman, in letters, speeches and formal meetings. In everyday talk, say «Cik» or «Puan».
L-1506.ja: 改まった言い方：女性への敬称、または改まった「あなた」。手紙、スピーチ、公式の場で使います。ふだんの会話では «Cik» や «Puan»。

frames.meaning_en: Good afternoon, Miss. How are you?
frames.meaning_ja: こんにちは。お元気ですか。（改まった言い方）

frames.example: Saya pun baik, terima kasih. Puan pula?
frames.meaning_en: I'm fine too, thank you. And you?
frames.meaning_ja: 私も元気です、ありがとうございます。あなたは？

frames.example: Selamat jalan, Cik Mei Ling. Hati-hati!
frames.meaning_en: Goodbye, Ms Mei Ling (you are leaving). Take care on the way!
frames.meaning_ja: （帰る人に）さようなら、メイリンさん。気をつけて！

frames.frame: Maaf, ___, saya minta diri dulu. Jumpa ___ ___.
frames.example: Maaf, Puan, saya minta diri dulu. Jumpa esok pagi.
frames.meaning_en: Excuse me, I'll be going now. See you tomorrow morning.
frames.meaning_ja: すみません、お先に失礼します。また明日の朝。

frames.example: Selamat malam, Pak cik. Jaga diri, ya!
frames.meaning_en: Good night, uncle. Take care of yourself!
frames.meaning_ja: おやすみなさい、おじさん。体に気をつけてね！
